plan_review.notes: Alt A: derive passives from skill level + equipped weapon during stat recompute (rejected — requires invasive statsSystem rewrite, no benefit for player-only feature). Alt B: encode ability grant on skill milestone definition not side map (deferred — valid future improvement, out of scope for this PR). Alt C: holder-scoped weapon state for multi-entity support (deferred — player-only scope is current constraint; guarded by hasComponent(Player) check). Resolved: removed lastWeaponGenerationByEntity cache (redundant + stale-EID risk), fixed unlockedAbilityCount to query only player entity, removed broad try/catch hiding real config errors, removed weaponChanged gate from revoke (now evaluates each frame cleanly). Save/load and multi-entity concerns documented as future work. 1-frame stat-application delay accepted as standard ECS behavior for passive bonuses.
